name: bamboohr-headcount
description: Explain why BambooHR report and employee directory counts differ, and identify who appears in only one export. Use pasted text or exports to explain count gaps, missing fields and historical membership. Returns matched internal IDs, a count bridge and effective-date decisions.

interface.shortDescription: Reconcile BambooHR report and directory headcount.
interface.longDescription: Explain why BambooHR report and employee directory counts differ, and identify who appears in only one export. Use pasted text or exports to explain count gaps, missing fields and historical membership. Returns matched internal IDs, a count bridge and effective-date decisions.
